tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Noncharacteristic boundary conditions] ↗ def:noncharacteristic-triple 1. ch3:3.2-lem-1\group Method of Characteristics

Near a noncharacteristic admissible triple, the compatibility equation has a unique smooth solution \[ p_n^0=q(x^0,g(x^0),Dg(x^0)). \]

Proof

\sketch Apply the implicit function theorem to $F(g_{x_1}(x),\ldots ,g_{x_{n-1}}(x),p_n,g(x),x)=0$; the derivative in $p_n$ is nonzero by noncharacteristicity.

□
